comments.body:
"Cowboy Boots"
Hmmm... well, this can apparently be found in a shipwreck added in the Wild West update ("Hazel"?), though I'm not sure of much else as yet. It was also released in the Wild West Mystery Bottle (10/22). Stats:

+1 Sniping
+1 Assault

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=Wild_West_Mystery_Bottle

However, there's also a color-custom version available from Aide Production. It's an R11 Handicrafts recipe (you'll need an aide with HC skill +1, naturally or added) that appears with 19th Century Chrono Quest title equipped, and is +1 Livestock Trading.

Source: gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=4741 (recipe), dolfuku.blog-mmo.com/靴・ブーツ/カウボーイブーツ (images)
